test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

You have said that, / as he took money from you many times, / he owes you / five thousand rupees all together.

options.text: as he took money from you many times

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct phrase should be "**altogether**," not "all together".
 
• "Altogether" means "entirely" or "in total", while "all together" means "all in one place".
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"You have said that, as he took money from you many times, he owes you five thousand rupees altogether."*
